filesystem._comment: Reads/writes files under MCP_FILESYSTEM_ROOT. The npm_config_* vars silence npm's update-notifier banner, which otherwise prints to stdout and corrupts the JSON-RPC stream over stdio.

tavily._comment: Official Tavily web search server (tavily-ai/tavily-mcp). Exposes tavily_search, tavily_extract, tavily_crawl, tavily_map, tavily_research.

fetch._comment: Additional MCP server (modelcontextprotocol/servers reference implementation). Retrieves a single known URL's content -- complements tavily_search, which is for query-based discovery rather than a specific link.
